findings.detail: return at line 4380 in 'dict_merge' leaves the critical section opened by Py_BEGIN_CRITICAL_SECTION(a) at line 4321 without calling Py_END_CRITICAL_SECTION() first — the per-object lock leaks on this path. Call Py_END_CRITICAL_SECTION() before the exit (or restructure so the exit is inside the section's END).
